scope: Follow-up review of store categories, recommendations, filters and scroll/preview lifetime

findings.title: Search retains the previous browsing category while displaying all templates
findings.reproduction: Choose travel, open store search, search for a daily-life template. The search header says all templates, but the shared feed still contains only travel templates and the expected daily-life result is absent.
findings.cause: Both route instances watch the same storeTemplateFeedProvider; the new route starts with local category set to all without acquiring an independent feed scope.
findings.recommendation: Separate the search feed/filter scope from the retained browsing route; resetting the shared feed alone would desynchronize the original route.
findings.test: search opened after a category selection searches the full catalog

findings.title: Programmatic return to all leaves the selected category chip outside the horizontal viewport
findings.reproduction: Reveal/select recommended at the leading edge of the horizontal shelf, reach the recommendation footer, and tap all templates. Results change correctly, but the newly selected all chip remains clipped outside the shelf. Reproduces with both grid and editorial lists.
findings.evidence: All-chip rect x=-45.8..12.0 while the shelf starts at x=20.0; vertical filter reveal succeeds.
findings.cause: The selection callback restores only the vertical filter anchor. The stateless horizontal shelf does not reveal a programmatically selected chip.
findings.recommendation: Reveal the selected chip on programmatic selection changes while preserving manual horizontal scrolling.
tests: recommended footer returns to usable all controls, editorial=false
recommended footer returns to usable all controls, editorial=true
